method: two bilateral envelopes, one per peer counterparty identity (design §6) -- Bank of America (exact) and Citibank (band). Scope elements drawn from generate_syndicate_internal.py's PLANS vocabulary (the same one Task 7's syndicate_projection_plan rows use); asymmetry grounded against Task 6's competition_law_rule rows, checked here at generation time

envelopes.rationale: primary co-lender, exact precision. We request their own position (rating, workout posture -- at their discretion to share, not ours to disclose) and their own filed commitment figure (per-lender shares do not reconcile against any facility total, design §7, so confirming directly is a real desk need). We disclose only syndicate composition and our own vote posture -- never own_position outbound, honouring CLR-003's ban on informally sharing our workout intent.

band precision, a narrower relationship -- Citibank both requests and discloses fewer elements than BofA (one against two in each direction), not a subset of BofA's scopes -- the request sides do not overlap at all. We request only their vote posture (not their full position) and disclose only syndicate composition (not our own vote posture back). A band-precision peer receives and grants less than an exact-precision one.
